name: edea
description: E.D.E.A shared workflow skills — house conventions for the tools we run on, one plugin per tool.

plugins.name: edea-linear
plugins.description: Shared E.D.E.A workflows for Linear: creating and updating issues in house format, checking the company's Confluence Brain before drafting.

plugins.name: edea-confluence
plugins.description: E.D.E.A's Confluence Brain: writing, reading, retiring and health-checking pages in house format, keeping them connected to each other and to the Linear work they came from, and speaking up when a session touches something the Brain already knows.

plugins.name: edea-presentations
plugins.description: E.D.E.A presentations: executive-grade deck briefs in Hebrew or English, generated into real NotebookLM slide decks.

plugins.name: edea-fireflies
plugins.description: Fireflies meeting recordings: nameless meeting summaries filed into the Confluence Brain, and answers about what was said.

plugins.name: edea-mortgage-survey
plugins.description: Create and edit mortgage-survey questionnaires from chat: propose, review the diff, apply, simulate respondent paths.
